title: Celestial dual of conformal gravity MHV amplitudes: an OPE analysis
summary: In an earlier paper [arXiv:2511.03669] we extracted the OPE of celestial CFT operator duals of positive helicity graviton and scalar particles from the Mellin transformed relevant MHV amplitudes of conformal gravity, realised as the bosonic subsector of the Berkovits-Witten theory. A soft theorem analysis of bulk MHV amplitudes established that this conformal gravity exhibits a chiral $\mathfrak{bms}_4$ symmetry on the celestial sphere with the associated $\mathfrak{sl}(2,\mathbb{R})$ current algebra, which acquires a non-trivial central extension, unlike the Einstein gravity.
